reviews.x: I ordered a #1/2 (1.5mm) clip for my Wahl clippers.  Unfortunately, the tines broke the first time the clip was used.  It fit snugly on my Wahl clipppers and the metal reinforced clip held it nicely in place.  However, once I began using it, two of the tines bent and broke.  I compared the clip to my older Wahl clips (from >20 years ago) and found that the newer plastic was very thin and bent much too easily.  My older clips are much sturdier and have withstood hundreds of cuttings.  The photos

My original was causing clippers to make noise. Looked at other "all plastic" replacements but was hesitant. Found this one and it looked like the original. Order it and it arrived in two days. Fits perfectly and clippers are whisper quiet again with this attachment.  Don't be fooled by all plastic versions. Spend a little extra and get high quality! Glad I did.

reviews.t: I was glad to find this and buy it separately as it ...
reviews.x: Just to be clear, this is a Wahl 1/2 (not the 1/2 inch). It is what I was hoping for, the Number 1/2 which is 1.5mm or 1/16th inch (not 1/2"). I was glad to find this and buy it separately as it seems to usually only come in a package. Very sturdy, the Premium is way better than the standard cutting guides.

We have a Wahl Sterling 4 clipper. It's a good clipper, but the set of guards that comes with it doesn't include a 1/2 size. The plain plastic 1/2 guard is stupidly expense for a single cheapo item, so I opted for this once, which is supposed to be nicer and more durable.  Unfortunately, one of the teeth (tines?) broke off on very first use.  Also, my clipper just seemed to have a harder time cutting with it. It took my wife over 30 minutes to shave my head, versus the usual 15 with the size 1 g

Bought this guard as replacement for one whose teeth had broken after years of use. On first use, the clippers (Wahl MC3) immediately sheared off several of the teeth from the guard.  Seems to be a design defect, as several other reviewers encountered the same problem. Sending it back.

This attachment replaced the attachment that came with my clippers.  The quality is much better than the original.  It is made with high quality materials and the durability is better. In the end, I got a cleaner and closer cut.  This is a MUST have.

Only used it once so far but in comparison to the plastic guards that come with the clippers these are a lot sturdier and hold on to the clippers better with no movement of either the guard itself or the teeth

reviews.t: A Cut Above the Other Wahl Guards
reviews.x: I bought this to use with a Wahl Color Pro clipper set because the 1/2 guard included with it seemed to be a bit flimsy.  While it would likely last for a while, I like the peace of mind of having more stability with a guard that cuts so close.  Having read some of the reviews of that clipper set, someone mentioned the Wahl Professional series.  This guard uses the metal clip to stabilize the guard and it makes a world of difference.  While I cannot confirm that the plastic itself is any differe

reviews.t: On and off the clippers hundreds of times and it still holds up
reviews.x: I bought this guard because every ½ guard that has ever come with a set of clippers that I've had has eventually cracked or teeth have broken off. I've had this guard for a couple years now and taken it on and off the clippers probably 200 times and it has never cracked. The metal clip on the end is very sturdy. The teeth are sturdy too. Even though they are plastic, not a single one has broken off. I've even dropped the clippers on the floor with the guard on before, and nothing broke. Definite

reviews.t: Much better than the flimsy plastic guides included with the Magic Clip
reviews.x: The original snap-on plastic guides that come with the Wahl Magic Clip bend easily and always feel like they're going to pop off.  This guide is much more sturdy - it's made of stronger, stiffer plastic and is reinforced with a metal clip.  I'm no longer afraid that I'm going to give myself an unintentional buzzcut down to the skin.  Another side effect of the sturdier attachment of this clip is that the clippers are much quieter - with the original clip attached there was a lot of rattling beca

reviews.t: Solid and dependable for my haircutting
reviews.x: Got very nervous when my previous Wahl 1/2 comb broke - fortunately as I prepped to start my haircut.  Reading some online reviews, I found this version of the comb was a bit more durable than the all plastic version, so I figured it was a good replacement.  Then I started thinking about what I would have done if the comb I use had broken in the MIDDLE of my haircut??  I decided to order TWO so I'd have a backup.  I no longer worry about that embarrassing scenario.

reviews.t: Treat it smoothly and it should last you a long time.
reviews.x: You have to be very careful (as in treat it delicately). Given its small millimetric size teeth, they are more likely to break faster than say size #6. For obvious reasons, treat it with care. This is the only 'defect' i see in this but it's not really their fault (maybe making the plastic of harder/tougher material?) but overall this is a great buy. It fit wireless Wahl 79141 Battery Clipper perfectly.

reviews.t: Not What the Picture Showed it to be
reviews.x: The picture showed it to be a clipper guard with metal re-enforcement but when it arrived it was all plastic. So I sent it back. That's what I had before, and they are a very pure quality and break way to easily. You should not show a picture of one thing and ship another. I'll go to a salon-barber store and spend the money to get a quality clipper guard.

reviews.t: Much better than the stock cutting guide on my Wahl clippers.
reviews.x: I got a new heavy-duty-for-home-use (not professional barber/stylist quality) Wahl hair clipper a few months ago, and the stock cutting guide I use wore out very quickly. This one is much more robust, and so far working very well in my clipper. I can’t yet speak to long-term durability, but first impression is that this guide should last a long time.

Arrived new and unused. You're not going to get better quality. Just as good as the ones that comes in a set. I used this one time so far and it worked perfectly. No issues at all. Seems durable. I mean it is plastic so it's not going to be able to take a beating but as long as you take care of it, it will last you, just like anything else.

I am a hairstylist and I bought one few months ago.  This week I bought 2 more of 1/2 guard.  Can't believe how it cuts super better than a plastic Wahl guards I've been using for 20 years.  Btw, every tools and guards will break down easily if you don't take care well.  After use, wash guards with soap, rinse and towel dry.

I own the burgundy/reddish Wahl Balding Clipper and I purchased this attachment when I don't want itchy skin growing back after balding my head and mustache. The 1/16" height leaves just enough mustache stubble to blend-in with the overall balding, minus the itch, and it snaps on like a glove.

I bought this piece as a upgrade/ backup over to another guard I have for my clippers. After using it, it is obvious that this is a complete upgrade. It is so much more sturdier than my other plastic guard. I also like how it stays on the clippers. My other guard kept falling off.

If your using the original plastic guards, then it's one to upgrade to these clips. They are durable. It will give you the same results  but it will give you more confidence that the guards will not fall while cutting. I went ahead and brought every size I use to cut my hair.

reviews.t: Very durable and makes a world of a difference.
reviews.x: It is crazy how much of a difference this makes compared to the cheap plastic ones that come with most standard clippers. Much more durable and stay on guaranteed, which I believe makes for a better and much smoother cut. It was almost if I had brand new clippers again.

My kit seemed like it could use a smaller comb and this really did the trick. Just used it today after only receiving it two days ago. 11-21-22. I'm not that good with the clippers yet, I only cut my own hair but I'm glad I can use the Wahl tools to improve my craft.

Works perfectly for me and is a decent step up in quality from their colored version I had before. The metal piece gives stability, and I don't hear any major rattling. It is spendy, but for me it was worth it as it's the best cut for guys that need it short.

hubby dropped his old one and it snapped one of the tiny fingers off. it was part of a set that came with his clippers so he was afraid he would have to buy a whole set to replace the one. thankfully we found this and it was an exact copy of the one he had.

I use the 1/16" cutting guide to keep my beard short.  After having the guide for less than 96 hours and only ONE use, the ratings could conceivably change.  Being asked to give ratings after VERY limited experience seems premature to me.

claims.text: Many reviewers find this guard sturdier and better quality than the standard all-plastic guards that come with clippers, praising the metal-reinforced clip and snug fit.
A notable number of reviewers report the tines/teeth breaking or shearing off on first use, calling it flimsy and a waste of money.
Some reviewers note the guard requires careful, delicate handling because its small teeth are prone to breaking.
At least one reviewer received an all-plastic guard that did not match the metal-reinforced picture shown.
Several reviewers highlight long-term durability, reporting the guard holds up after many uses and repeated on/off cycles.
